result:
I created `docs/policies/async-runtime.md`. It says the project's current recorded decision is tokio, chosen because its ecosystem is bigger.

The runtime isn't in Muninn's catalog, so I checked the session records with `muninn why`. It returned two conflicting records. An earlier session said "async-std runtime", and a later one (#16, two seconds after) said "tokio, ecosystem is bigger". I treated tokio as the newest word on the subject and left async-std out of the file.

Both are trust-1 episodes, not formal decisions, so this rests on their order alone. If you meant async-std to stand, tell me and I'll change the file.
